## 2026-11-15：Analytics 源基准重复 key 归因完成，仍阻断

不是本轮San生成/repair Prompt问题：冻结Vue的TrendChart第148行网格g使用key=i（1–5），第173行数据g用key=idx（默认0–29）。编译与原生规范化VNode确证35个带键g为同组svg直接兄弟，重叠1–5。完整源重放仍10条重复键警告；旧harness经console.error转发Vue warning，并非10种业务异常，源warning继续阻断。

使用源脚本导出的同一TrendChart做1/2/7/30/90点父传props两次更新机制对照。仅在对照夹具给两组key分别加grid-/point-命名空间：原警告0/2/10/10/10，对照均0，五对画面零差异。未改冻结源码、未生成源勘误版本、不算真实7天/90天/刷新交互验收或迁移通过；只证明这处重复键机制，不证明任意变化序列。

最终12原生页身份/处置完整，42诊断均原生归属，完整源10+机制原模板32；完整San及命名空间对照无诊断。完整源/目标业务字段和截图SHA与旧记录一致，Vue1326/San1625高度、7项关键矩形差仍存在，不能把它们都归因于key或宣称命名空间已消除。五对可比PNG指标独立重算一致，全组件尺寸不同不缩放/编造SSIM。

首轮12页诊断夹具失败保留于native/且有独立seal和failed_implementation.json：新增观察表达式语法错误使源页ready超时，单点polyline零面积不适合作为必需正面积关键元素。只修观察括号、加全页面脚本预检、用可见legend作为单点必需元素并继续只读记录points；通用渲染器/阈值/源码不改，新native_retry/重跑，不把夹具失败记为组件生产缺陷或修复回归。

最终205/205定向测试（本步16+历史口径46+原生反馈90+归属53），非全仓库或上一轮249campaign；100旧文件、3人工配置、4参考、6冻结SFC、30对主Vue、上步114payload及旧原生96payload/closeout不变。Notebook只追加，前145单元及metadata保留；编译所有代码、在根目录和Notebook目录执行本只读单元，不打开UI。报告技能将源基准remaining_risk、夹具失败、机制控制与目标缺陷分开，不回填旧24/30/失败6/token1,821,544或新增人工确认。

源oracle仍blocked；Analytics三个交互场景执行0，公开键/通知/异常不豁免，生产接入未就绪，模型/新人工/commit/push0。下一步需要用户明确决定是否另建仅改两处key的独立源码勘误版本；旧输入/结果不动，批准后也需新基准/指纹绑定，再单独处理布局及交互。未批准就保留阻断，不吞警告/改生产版运行时/暗改源码/剔除样本。

报告：`data/experiments/analysis/analytics_source_oracle_audit_v1_20261115/REPORT.md`。以下只读检查，不启动模型、浏览器或Notebook UI。

from pathlib import Path
import json, hashlib, re, runpy
root = next(p for p in [Path.cwd(), *Path.cwd().parents] if (p/'migration_pipeline').is_dir() and (p/'notebooks').is_dir())
base = root/'data/experiments/analysis/analytics_source_oracle_audit_v1_20261115'
read = lambda p: json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
lines = (base/'SHA256SUMS.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
for line in lines:
    pin, relative = line.split('  ',1)
    p = (base/relative).resolve()
    assert p.is_relative_to(base.resolve()) and sha(p) == pin,relative
implementation = read(base/'implementation.json')
assert len(implementation['files']) == 3 and not implementation['source_or_target_modified']
for path, item in implementation['files'].items():
    assert sha(root/path) == item['sha256']
    assert (root/path).read_text(encoding='utf-8') == item['frozen_source']
audit = runpy.run_path(str(root/'migration_pipeline/check_analytics_source_oracle_v1.py'))['audit']()
assert audit == read(base/'audit.json')
assert audit['status'] == 'diagnosis_complete_source_oracle_blocked'
assert audit['native']['native_source_warnings'] == 10 and audit['native']['total_native_diagnostics'] == 42
assert audit['native']['unresolved_layout_differences'] == 7 and audit['native']['interaction_scenarios_executed'] == 0
assert not audit['source_correction_authorized'] and not audit['warning_waiver_granted']
assert not audit['production_ready'] and not audit['native']['comprehensive_migration_pass']
failure = read(base/'failed_implementation.json')
assert sha(base/'native/SHA256SUMS.txt') == failure['seal_sha256']
assert hashlib.sha256(failure['frozen_source'].encode()).hexdigest() == failure['sha256']
assert not read(base/'native/result.json')['nativeRegistry']['complete']
tests = read(base/'tests.json')
assert tests['tests'] == 205 and tests['successful']
assert sorted(row['tests'] for row in tests['reports']) == [16,46,53,90]
for row in tests['reports']:
    assert row['failures'] == row['errors'] == row['skipped'] == 0 and row['successful']
    assert int(re.search(r'Ran (\d+) tests',row['log'])[1]) == row['tests']
    assert re.search(r'\nOK\s*$',row['log'])
replay = read(base/'metric_replay.json')
assert replay['readOnly'] and replay['comparisonsRecomputed'] == 5 and len(replay['checks']) == 6
assert replay['checks'][0]['metrics'] is None
baseline = read(base/'baseline.json')
append = read(base/'notebook_append.json')
nb = read(root/baseline['notebook']['path'])
stable = lambda v: hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(v,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
assert stable(nb['cells'][:145]) == baseline['notebook']['cells_sha256']
assert stable(nb['metadata']) == baseline['notebook']['metadata_sha256']
assert nb['cells'][145:147] == append['cells']
scope = (root/'docs/ir-design/source-migration-scope-20261114.md').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(scope[:baseline['scope_prefix']['bytes']]).hexdigest() == baseline['scope_prefix']['sha256']
assert append['scope_append'] in scope.decode('utf-8')
print({'source_oracle':'blocked_duplicate_sibling_keys','native_source_warnings':10,'mechanism_pairs':5,'targeted_tests':205,'real_interactions':0,'source_modified':False,'model_calls':0,'production_ready':False,'old_batch':'unchanged 24/30','sealed_payloads':len(lines)})

scope_append: 2026-11-15（Analytics源基准审查）：见 `data/experiments/analysis/analytics_source_oracle_audit_v1_20261115/REPORT.md`。确证源TrendChart第148/173行两组svg直接兄弟g分别用1–5及0–29数字key，规范化VNode重叠1–5；完整源重放仍10条重复键警告，不能归为San生成/repair问题或吞掉。1/2/7/30/90点原模板与仅key命名空间的机制控制显示原警告0/2/10/10/10、控制均0且画面不变；控制不写回、不当源勘误或真实交互验收。最终12原生页身份/处置完整，42诊断归属明确，5对PNG指标独立重算一致；全源/目标业务与截图SHA同旧记录，1326/1625高度与7项矩形差仍保留，未归因给key或宣称消除。首次新观察语法与单点零面积polyline关键选择失败已单独seal保留，只修诊断夹具后新目录重跑；不改冻结源码、旧渲染器/Prompt/规则/阈值/分派。205项定向测试通过（16+46+90+53，非全仓库或上步249campaign）；100旧文件、3人工配置、4参考、6冻结SFC、30对主Vue、上步114payload及旧原生96payload不变。Notebook只追加保留145单元和metadata，旧24/30与token1,821,544不回填。Analytics交互仍0、源oracle继续阻断、公开键/通知/异常不豁免；下一步需用户决定是否另建只改两处key的独立源码勘误版本，批准后重建基准/绑定，再独立查布局/交互，不暗改源或排除样本。无LLM/新人工通过/commit/push，不扩互操作或业务输入要求。
